scripts.setup: uv sync --dev && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.dev: pnpm run openapi && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "pnpm run backend" "pnpm run frontend"
scripts.check: pnpm run openapi && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run front:check
